extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern “GREAT Life Multiplier” is a life insurance solution used as the base for critical illness coverage via an optional “Critical Illness Multiplier Rider (E&I)” (early & intermediate stage and critical stage). The rider uses a multiplier to scale the insured critical illness benefit, with examples shown: for Lola, the early/intermediate portion is “S$30,000 (multiplied 5 times to S$150,000 until age 75)” and the critical-stage portion is “S$50,000 (multiplied 5 times to S$250,000 until age 75)”; for Mike, the same structure is “S$30,000 (multiplied 10 times to S$300,000 until age 65)” and “S$50,000 (multiplied 10 times to S$500,000 until age 65).” A “Parent Care Rider” provides age-related-condition coverage without medical assessment for parents (example mentions Severe Dementia/Alzheimer’s), and a “Payer Benefit Enhanced (CI) Rider” waives future premiums upon a critical illness diagnosis (as stated). The brochure also mentions “Special Benefits” under the CI Multiplier Rider (E&I) paying “25% of the rider sum assured” (up to six claims).

policies.quick_summary: Base participating life plan that provides a Death Benefit, with optional riders including Critical Illness Multiplier Rider (E&I), Parent Care Rider (age-related conditions without medical assessment), Payer Benefit Enhanced (CI) Rider (premium waiver on critical illness diagnosis), and CI Multiplier “Special Benefits” paying 25% of rider sum assured (up to six claims). Beneficiary access is referenced, subject to a nomination condition. Limited pay applies to the base plan and critical illness rider(s), not the Parent Care Rider (per the text). Age is stated as “age next birthday”. All ages specified refer to age next birthday.
